assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: An evidence-backed disposition ledger for every reported regression finding and uncovered behavior area.
assessments.rationale: It offers development, review, testing, and deployment discipline, but is a whole feature-delivery pipeline rather than a process for consuming a coverage-led regression report and accounting for every finding and coverage area.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A workflow to verify software behavior findings against the checkout, fix proven regressions, and report dispositions.
assessments.rationale: It is a jurisdiction-specific workflow for England and Wales witness evidence, not review and remediation of software behavior regressions in a checkout.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Current-checkout regression verification, remediation, and a per-item disposition ledger.
assessments.rationale: It adversarially reviews a completed proposal before specifications and design, rather than validating a regression report against a current codebase and performing proven fixes.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Software checkout review, regression fixes, and an evidence-backed disposition ledger.
assessments.rationale: It runs gene-set enrichment analysis on ranked gene lists, which has no plausible software-regression-review route.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Direct handling and closure of each regression-report finding and uncovered behavior area.
assessments.rationale: It can consume structural quality-gate feedback, create ledgers, and avoid user-visible regressions, but its primary report semantics are structural/decomposition concerns rather than a coverage-led user-visible regression report.

It directly consumes a coverage-led regression report, verifies every user-visible finding against the checkout, fixes only proven regressions, handles stale or intentional changes, closes coverage gaps, produces a disposition for every item, and preserves unstaged Git state.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Direct regression and behavior-coverage assessment for every reported user-visible finding.
assessments.rationale: It supplies an evidence-led report-consumption and disposition workflow with unchanged Git staging, but its central object is hack-risk and ownership issues rather than user-visible behavior regression findings and behavior coverage.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A process to validate behavior regressions against code, fix proven issues, and return a disposition ledger.
assessments.rationale: It prepares formal RFP and security-questionnaire responses, not current-checkout regression validation and remediation.
